title: Restricted coefficient maps on an injective roof
statement: Let v:Z→X, φ:F→v_*G, and injective resolutions I of F and J of G be given. Let L be a nonnegative complex of injectives on X, ell:v_*J→L a quasi-isomorphism, and beta:I→L with Iota_I beta=φ v_*(Iota_J) ell in degree zero. For U open in X, let R and R-prime be the prescribed restricted resolutions on U and v inverse U [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write a_I,a_J for the classical-to-raw integer-indexed section comparisons [def-weil-pbc-square-resolution-roof-models], and extend ell to ell_Z:v_*(J extended)→L extended using mapExtendIso. Then moduleCohomologyFMap(v restricted to U, restrictedDirectImageMap φ,q);a_J;H^q Γ(U,ell_Z) equals a_I;H^q Γ(U,beta extended). This involves one scheme morphism and no total derived functor.

proof.text: Apply the natural-indexed restricted coefficient-roof theorem, which constructs the restricted roof and identifies the classical map by independence of choices.

Naturality of extendHomologyIso and mapExtendIso transports this natural-indexed equality to the integer complexes. For the denominator use the composition equation for mapExtendIso with v_* followed by Γ(U,-). This also covers degree zero and the empty open.

theorem restrictedCoefficient_roof {X Z : Scheme.{u}} (v : Z ⟶ X)
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Z.Modules) (φ : F ⟶ (pushforward v).obj G)
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (J : InjectiveResolution G)
    (L : CochainComplex X.Modules ℕ) (hL : ∀ n : ℕ, Injective (L.X n))
    (ell : ((pushforward v).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hell : QuasiIso ell) (beta : I.cocomplex ⟶ L)
    (hbeta : I.ι.f 0 ≫ beta.f 0 = φ ≫ (pushforward v).map (J.ι.f 0) ≫ ell.f 0)
    (U : X.Opens) (R : RestrictedResolutionSections I U)
    (R' : RestrictedResolutionSections J (v ⁻¹ᵁ U)) (q : ℕ) :
    let Γ := (RingedSpace.openModuleSections X.toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)
    let H := HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u}
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (q : ℤ)
    let ellZ := (J.cocomplex.mapExtendIso ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (pushforward v)).hom ≫
      HomologicalComplex.extendMap ell ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    let betaZ := HomologicalComplex.extendMap beta ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat
    moduleCohomologyFMap (v.resLE U (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl)
      (restrictedDirectImageMap v φ U) q ≫
      (squareResolutionCohomologyIso J (v ⁻¹ᵁ U) R' q).hom ≫ H.map (Γ.map ellZ) =
    (squareResolutionCohomologyIso I U R q).hom ≫ H.map (Γ.map betaZ)
